posts.title: Mining Haul Truck V4: a glue-free 3D print kit
posts.text: 78 parts, no supports, no glue. Pins with snap-in E-clips for everything that moves, crush-rib dowels for everything that stays. The body tips to 38 degrees on a built-in hinge stop and the front axle steers about 12 degrees each way.

posts.title: Five 1000-design mega bundles for laser, CNC and 3D printing
posts.text: Wheels, gears, brake rotors, keychain tags and car Christmas ornaments. Every design is checked by software: one connected piece, no micro holes, a 1 mm minimum feature at default size and watertight STL files.

posts.title: Print the fit test first: how to tune pins and dowels on any printer
posts.text: Every VESSO GO kit includes a small fit-test coupon. Pins should slide into the 5.4 mm hole with light finger pressure; dowels should grip in the 3.2 mm hole. If they are tight, raise your slicer's XY hole compensation by 0.1 mm. If dowels are loose, reprint them at 102 % XY scale.
